definitions.notional_dollars: count_fp x yes_price_dollars — the YES-leg premium. Not the same quantity as the leaderboard's dollar volume, which prices each fill at the taker's own side (yes price for YES, no price for NO). Both formulas are printed wherever their number appears.

live_trade_sample.note: First records of GET /markets/trades?limit=120 (exchange-wide, newest first). Used to demonstrate the dollar-volume computation. The leaderboard on the site is recomputed live from the same endpoint, over many pages.
live_trade_sample.dollar_volume_formula: notional = count_fp x taker_price, where taker_price = yes_price_dollars when taker_outcome_side == 'yes' else no_price_dollars

orderbook_sample.interpretation: Bids only, ascending by price, best bid last. YES BID at X = NO ASK at $1.00-X. Depth = contracts resting at each price.

candlesticks_sample.constraint: period_interval accepts only 1 (minute), 60 (hour), 1440 (day). start_ts/end_ts required, in seconds. Max 5,000 periods per request.

settled_market_example.purpose: Evidence for the 'how did the event resolve (yes/no)' requirement: the fields that carry the answer.

resolution_field_notes: result is lowercase 'no' / 'yes' on the market object; empty string while unresolved.
status for a settled market came back as 'finalized', while the request used the filter value 'settled'. The filter vocabulary and the object vocabulary differ — logged as FLAG-02.

observations: notional_value_dollars = "1.0000" on every market sampled: one YES contract pays $1.00 on the winning side.
There is no dollar-volume field on the market object: only volume_fp (contracts) and volume_24h_fp (contracts).
There is no liquidity field on the market object in this API version. Resting size is per-level in yes_bid_size_fp / yes_ask_size_fp and in the orderbook endpoint.
status came back as 'active' for markets requested with status=open.
Newly created exchange-wide multivariate (combo) markets appear at the top of GET /markets?status=open because results are sorted by creation time, newest first.
These rows carry is_provisional=true, mve_collection_ticker, mve_selected_legs and a custom_strike block, and volume_fp may be 0.00 while open_interest_fp is 100.00.

Any 'top by volume' ranking built by paging GET /markets from newest to oldest will therefore be dominated by brand-new combo markets. Ranking must be done from GET /markets/trades or by filtering on volume. Logged as FLAG-01.

series_volume_observations.note: volume_fp is the official series-level field returned when include_volume=true: 'total number of contracts traded across all events in this series'. It is a CONTRACT COUNT, not a dollar figure. Definition source: https://docs.kalshi.com/api-reference/market/get-series-list.md
